conbody.p: Smart Motor Sensor requires approximately 7 days to create an initial model of how the motor operates in its unique environment*. Smart Motor Sensor will not predict faults during this stage.
conbody.note: Note: Smart Motor Sensor only learns when the motor is in operation, and the Sensor is within proximity of a stable Wi-Fi connection.
